q23318.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle T passes last.

explain.short: T has A on its right and it turns left, so it waits for R and A.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is correct: T goes after R and A.

sceneParams.caption: Order R, A, T: T goes last

q23319.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle R passes first.

explain.short: Nobody comes from R's right, so R does not have to give way to anyone.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is correct: R has a free right side.

sceneParams.caption: R has a free right: R goes first

q23320.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle A must wait for vehicle R to pass.

explain.short: R comes from A's right, so A must let R pass first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'deve attendere' (must wait) is correct: R is on A's right.

sceneParams.caption: R is on A's right: A waits

q23321.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle T must wait for vehicles R and A to pass.

explain.short: A comes from T's right, and T turns left, so T lets both R and A go first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'dei veicoli R ed A' (both R and A) is correct: T is the last one.

sceneParams.caption: T waits for R and A

q23322.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles pass in the order: R, A, T.

explain.short: R has a free right, A has R on its right, T has A on its right and turns left.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: Check the order letter by letter: 'R, A, T' is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: R, A, T

q23323.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle T passes before vehicle R.

explain.short: T goes last: it has A on its right and it turns left. R goes first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo R' (before R) is wrong: R goes first, T last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R goes first, T goes last

q23324.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles pass in the order: R, T, A.

explain.short: A must pass before T, because A comes from T's right.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'R, T, A' swaps T and A: the right order is R, A, T.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is R, A, T

q23325.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles pass in the order: T, A, R.

explain.short: This is the order turned upside down: R goes first and T goes last.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'T, A, R' is the reverse of the right order R, A, T.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is R, A, T

q23326.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle T passes before the other vehicles.

explain.short: T has A on its right and turns left, so it passes after all the others.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'prima degli altri' (before the others) is wrong: T is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: T goes last, not first

q23327.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A passes last.

explain.short: E and S come from A's right, and they wait for D. So A waits for all three.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is correct: A goes after D, E and S.

sceneParams.caption: Order D, E, S, A: A goes last

q23328.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A must give way to vehicles E and S.

explain.short: E and S arrive from A's right, so A must let them pass.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'ai veicoli E e S' is correct: both are on A's right.

sceneParams.caption: E and S are on A's right

q23329.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A, before entering the junction, must wait for vehicles D, E and S to pass, in this order.

explain.short: D goes first (free right), then E and S (D was on their right), and only then A.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'nell'ordine' (in this order) D, E, S is correct; A comes after them.

sceneParams.caption: A waits for D, then E, then S

q23330.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A has a free right side.

explain.short: E and S are coming from A's right, so A's right side is not free.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'ha la destra libera' (has a free right) is wrong: E and S are there.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: E and S are on A's right

keywords.en: has a free right side (nobody coming from the right)

q23331.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A passes at the same time as vehicle D.

explain.short: D goes first; A goes last, after E and S.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: D is first, A is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: D goes first, A goes last

q23332.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A passes after vehicles E and S, but before vehicle D.

explain.short: D has a free right and goes first, so A cannot pass before D.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'ma prima del veicolo D' (but before D) is wrong: D goes first of all.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: D goes first, A last

q23333.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A must give way only to the vehicle going straight on and not to those turning.

explain.short: A gives way to every vehicle on its right, E going straight and S turning alike.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: turning vehicles on your right also have priority.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A gives way to E AND S

q23334.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A must give way to vehicle L.

explain.short: L comes from A's right, so A must let L pass first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Two vehicles can go together when their paths do not cross.
explain.trap: 'al veicolo L' is correct: L is on A's right.

sceneParams.caption: L is on A's right: L goes first

q23335.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A can cross the junction together with vehicle C, after vehicle L has passed.

explain.short: A and C come from the same road and their paths do not cross, so after L they go together.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Two vehicles can go together when their paths do not cross.
explain.trap: 'insieme' (together) is correct here: A turns left, C goes straight beside it.

sceneParams.caption: After L, A and C go together

q23336.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A has priority over vehicle D.

explain.short: D comes from A's left. A is on D's right, so D must give way to A.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Two vehicles can go together when their paths do not cross.
explain.trap: 'ha la precedenza' (has priority) is correct: D is on A's left.

sceneParams.caption: A goes before D

q23337.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A must give way to all vehicles.

explain.short: A gives way only to L, on its right. D waits for A, and C goes with A.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Two vehicles can go together when their paths do not cross.
explain.trap: 'a tutti i veicoli' (to all vehicles) is wrong: only L.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A gives way only to L

q23338.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle A passes last.

explain.short: D goes last, because A and C are on its right. A passes before D.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. Two vehicles can go together when their paths do not cross.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is wrong: D is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: D goes last, not A

q23339.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle B must give way to vehicle N.

explain.short: B turns left and N comes from the opposite side going straight, so B lets N pass.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'al veicolo N' is correct: N is the oncoming car.

sceneParams.caption: B turns left: it lets oncoming N pass

q23340.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle B enters the junction before vehicle R.

explain.short: B is on R's right, so R must wait. B moves into the junction first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'impegna l'incrocio' (enters the junction) before R is correct.

sceneParams.caption: B enters before R

q23341.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle B can complete the left turn after vehicle N has passed.

explain.short: B waits in the centre for the oncoming N, then finishes its left turn.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'concludere la manovra' (complete the turn) after N is correct.

sceneParams.caption: B finishes its turn after N

q23342.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle B, after moving to the centre of the junction, must wait for vehicle N to pass.

explain.short: B enters first and stops in the centre. There it lets the oncoming N pass.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'dopo essersi portato al centro' (after moving to the centre) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: B waits in the centre for N

keywords.en: in the centre of the junction

q23343.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle B has a free right side during the whole turn.

explain.short: B's right is free only at the start. In the centre B must wait for N.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'durante tutta la manovra' (during the whole turn) is wrong: N gets in the way.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: in the centre B waits for N

q23344.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle B must enter the junction last because it turns left.

explain.short: B has a free right, so it enters first. Turning left only means waiting for oncoming N.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo ... perché svolta a sinistra' is wrong: B enters first.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B enters first

q23345.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle B must give way to vehicle R, which goes straight on.

explain.short: R comes from B's left, not from the front. R must wait for B.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'al veicolo R' is wrong: R is on B's left, and going straight does not change that.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R is on B's left, R waits

q23346.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle P must give way to vehicles T and G.

explain.short: P has a give way sign, so it lets the tram and G on the main road pass.
explain.rule: Signs come before the right-hand rule: with a give way sign you let everyone on the main road pass. Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'ai veicoli T e G' is correct: both are on the main road.

sceneParams.caption: Give way: P lets the tram and G pass

q23347.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle P has priority over vehicle B.

explain.short: Both have a give way sign. B turns left, so B lets the oncoming P pass.
explain.rule: Signs come before the right-hand rule: with a give way sign you let everyone on the main road pass. Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'ha la precedenza sul veicolo B' is correct: B turns left in front of P.

sceneParams.caption: P goes before B (B turns left)

q23348.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle P passes after the tram and vehicle G, but before vehicle B.

explain.short: The tram and G are on the main road, so they go first. B turns left, so it waits for P.
explain.rule: Signs come before the right-hand rule: with a give way sign you let everyone on the main road pass. Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise.
explain.trap: Every part is right: after the tram and G, 'ma prima del veicolo B' (but before B).

sceneParams.caption: Order: tram, G, P, B

q23349.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle P passes at the same time as vehicle B, but after the tram.

explain.short: P and B cannot go together: B turns left across P's path and must wait. Also G goes before P.
explain.rule: Signs come before the right-hand rule: with a give way sign you let everyone on the main road pass. Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: B waits for P.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: P goes before B, not with it

q23350.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle P has priority over all vehicles.

explain.short: P has a give way sign: it must wait for the tram and G. It goes before B only.
explain.rule: Signs come before the right-hand rule: with a give way sign you let everyone on the main road pass. Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'su tutti i veicoli' (over all vehicles) is wrong: only over B.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: P waits for the tram and G

q23351.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle P must give way only to the vehicle coming from its right.

explain.short: With a give way sign P lets pass vehicles from the right AND from the left: the tram and G.
explain.rule: Signs come before the right-hand rule: with a give way sign you let everyone on the main road pass. Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise.
explain.trap: 'solo' (only) is the trap: the give way sign covers both sides.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: P gives way to right AND left

q23352.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle E must give way to vehicle L.

explain.short: L comes from E's right, so E lets L pass first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: 'al veicolo L' is correct: L is on E's right.

sceneParams.caption: L is on E's right: L goes first

q23353.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle E must give way to the vehicle coming from its right.

explain.short: There are no signs, so E applies the right-hand rule and lets L pass.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: 'dalla sua destra' (from its right) is correct: that is the basic rule.

sceneParams.caption: E gives way to the right (L)

q23354.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle E is not obliged to give way to the trolleybus.

explain.short: The trolleybus comes from E's left and has no rails, so it has no priority over E.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: 'non ha l'obbligo' (is not obliged) is correct: a filobus is not a tram.

sceneParams.caption: The trolleybus is on E's left: it waits

q23355.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle E passes before truck N, after vehicle L has passed.

explain.short: E waits only for L, on its right. E is on the truck's right, so the truck waits for E.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: Both parts are right: 'prima dell'autocarro N' and 'dopo il transito del veicolo L'.

sceneParams.caption: Order: L, E, N, trolleybus

q23356.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle E passes after the trolleybus but before vehicle N.

explain.short: The trolleybus goes last: it has N on its right and turns left. E goes before it.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: 'dopo il filobus' (after the trolleybus) is wrong: the filobus is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the trolleybus goes last

q23357.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle E must give way to the truck because it goes straight on.

explain.short: The truck comes from E's left, so it waits for E. Going straight gives no priority.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: 'perché prosegue diritto' (because it goes straight) is wrong: going straight is not a reason.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the truck is on E's left

q23358.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle E has priority over vehicles coming from the right and from the left.

explain.short: E has L on its right and must give way to it. E has priority only over the left.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: 'da destra' (from the right) is wrong: L on the right goes before E.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: E gives way to L on the right

keywords.it: provenienti da destra e da sinistra
keywords.en: coming from the right and from the left

q23359.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the driver of vehicle E passes first.

explain.short: L comes from E's right, so L goes first and E goes second.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is wrong: L is first.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: L goes first, E second

q23360.en: At the junction in the picture, vehicle B must give way to vehicle S.

explain.short: S comes from B's right, so B lets S pass first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'al veicolo S' is correct: S is on B's right.

sceneParams.caption: S is on B's right: S goes first

q23361.en: At the junction in the picture, the order in which the vehicles pass is: S, B, L, D.

explain.short: Each vehicle waits for the one on its right: S, then B, then L, then D.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: Check the letters: 'S, B, L, D' is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: S, B, L, D

q23362.en: At the junction in the picture, the order in which the vehicles pass is: S, B, D and L at the same time.

explain.short: D has L on its right, so D must wait for L. They cannot go together.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'D e L contemporaneamente' (D and L at the same time) is wrong: L goes before D.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: L goes before D

q23363.en: At the junction in the picture, the order in which the vehicles pass is: S and D at the same time, B, L.

explain.short: D is the last one: it waits for L, which waits for B, which waits for S.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'S e D contemporaneamente' (S and D at the same time) is wrong: D is last.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: D goes last

q23364.en: At the junction in the picture, vehicle D passes before vehicle F.

explain.short: D is on the trolleybus F's right, so F waits for D.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo F' (before F) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: D goes before the trolleybus F

q23365.en: At the junction in the picture, the order in which the vehicles pass is: R, D, F.

explain.short: R has a free right, D has R on its right, F has D on its right and turns left.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: Check the letters: 'R, D, F' is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: R, D, F

q23366.en: At the junction in the picture, the trolleybus passes first because it is tied to the overhead electric line.

explain.short: A trolleybus has no rails, so it has no special priority. Here it goes last.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: 'vincolato alla linea elettrica aerea' (tied to the overhead line) is a false reason: only rails count.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the trolleybus goes last

q23367.en: At the junction in the picture, the order in which the vehicles pass is: F, R, D.

explain.short: The trolleybus F goes last, not first. The right order is R, D, F.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. A trolleybus (filobus) follows the normal rules: it is not a tram.
explain.trap: 'F, R, D' puts the trolleybus first: wrong.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is R, D, F

q23368.en: At the junction in the picture, vehicle T passes last.

explain.short: T has D on its right, D has B, B has R. So T waits for everyone.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Order R, B, D, T: T is last

q23369.en: At the junction in the picture, the order of priority of the vehicles is: R, B, D, T.

explain.short: Each vehicle waits for the one on its right: R, then B, then D, then T.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: Check the letters: 'R, B, D, T' is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: R, B, D, T

q23370.en: At the junction in the picture, vehicle D passes before vehicle B.

explain.short: B is on D's right, so D must wait for B.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo B' (before B) is wrong: B goes before D.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: B goes before D

q23371.en: At the junction in the picture, the order in which the vehicles pass is: N, A, R.

explain.short: N is on the main road and goes first. A and R have give way signs; A has a free right, so it goes before R.
explain.rule: With a give way sign you slow down and stop if needed, and let the main road pass. Between two vehicles with the same sign, use the right-hand rule.
explain.trap: Check the letters: 'N, A, R' is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: N, A, R

q23372.en: At the junction in the picture, vehicles A and R must, if necessary, stop.

explain.short: A and R have a give way sign: they slow down and stop if someone is coming on the main road.
explain.rule: With a give way sign you slow down and stop if needed, and let the main road pass. Between two vehicles with the same sign, use the right-hand rule.
explain.trap: 'se necessario' (if necessary) is correct: give way is not a STOP, you stop only when needed.

sceneParams.caption: Give way: stop only if needed

q23373.en: At the junction in the picture, vehicle A can pass before vehicle R, but after vehicle N.

explain.short: N on the main road goes first. Then A, which has a free right, goes before R.
explain.rule: With a give way sign you slow down and stop if needed, and let the main road pass. Between two vehicles with the same sign, use the right-hand rule.
explain.trap: Both parts are right: 'prima del veicolo R' and 'dopo il veicolo N'.

sceneParams.caption: Order: N, A, R

q23374.en: At the junction in the picture, the order in which the vehicles pass is: A, N, R.

explain.short: A has a give way sign, so it cannot go before N on the main road.
explain.rule: With a give way sign you slow down and stop if needed, and let the main road pass. Between two vehicles with the same sign, use the right-hand rule.
explain.trap: 'A, N, R' puts A before N: wrong, A must give way to N.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is N, A, R

q23375.en: At the junction in the picture, the order of priority of the vehicles is: N, R, A.

explain.short: N is first, but then A goes before R, not after.
explain.rule: With a give way sign you slow down and stop if needed, and let the main road pass. Between two vehicles with the same sign, use the right-hand rule.
explain.trap: 'N, R, A' swaps A and R: the right order is N, A, R.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is N, A, R

q23376.en: At the junction in the picture, vehicle T passes first.

explain.short: T is a tram on rails, so it has priority over the other vehicles.
explain.rule: Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise. Buses follow the normal right-hand rule.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is correct: the tram goes first.

sceneParams.caption: The tram T goes first

q23377.en: At the junction in the picture, the vehicles pass in the following order: T, P, M.

explain.short: The tram goes first, then P, then the bus M, which has P on its right.
explain.rule: Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise. Buses follow the normal right-hand rule.
explain.trap: Check the letters: 'T, P, M' is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: T, P, M

q23378.en: At the junction in the picture, vehicle M passes last.

explain.short: M has P on its right and must also wait for the tram, so it goes last.
explain.rule: Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise. Buses follow the normal right-hand rule.
explain.trap: 'per ultimo' (last) is correct.

sceneParams.caption: Bus M goes last

q23379.en: At the junction in the picture, vehicle M has priority because it is on a public service.

explain.short: A bus on public service has no special priority at junctions. M goes last.
explain.rule: Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise. Buses follow the normal right-hand rule.
explain.trap: 'perché è in servizio pubblico' (because it is a public service) is a false reason.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: a bus has no special priority

q23380.en: At the junction in the picture, the vehicles pass in the following order: T, M, P.

explain.short: M has P on its right, so P goes before M.
explain.rule: Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise. Buses follow the normal right-hand rule.
explain.trap: 'T, M, P' swaps M and P: the right order is T, P, M.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is T, P, M

q23381.en: At the junction in the picture, vehicle T can pass first, provided that vehicle M is not on a scheduled public service.

explain.short: The tram goes first in any case. The bus service makes no difference.
explain.rule: Trams (vehicles on rails) go before other vehicles, unless a sign or an officer says otherwise. Buses follow the normal right-hand rule.
explain.trap: 'purché' (provided that) adds a false condition: the tram's priority does not depend on the bus.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the tram goes first anyway

q23382.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle R passes first.

explain.short: Nobody comes from R's right, so R goes first.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. An oversized vehicle (veicolo eccezionale) has no special priority.
explain.trap: 'per primo' (first) is correct: R has a free right.

sceneParams.caption: R has a free right: R goes first

q23383.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles pass in the following order: R, D, A.

explain.short: R has a free right, D has R on its right, A has D on its right.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. An oversized vehicle (veicolo eccezionale) has no special priority.
explain.trap: Check the letters: 'R, D, A' is exactly right.

sceneParams.caption: Correct order: R, D, A

q23384.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicle D passes before vehicle R.

explain.short: R comes from D's right, so D must wait. Being oversized does not change this.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. An oversized vehicle (veicolo eccezionale) has no special priority.
explain.trap: 'prima del veicolo R' (before R) is wrong: R is on D's right.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: R goes before D

q23385.en: At the junction shown in the picture, the vehicles pass in the following order: D, A, R.

explain.short: R goes first, not last. The right order is R, D, A.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. An oversized vehicle (veicolo eccezionale) has no special priority.
explain.trap: 'D, A, R' puts R last: wrong, R has a free right.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: the order is R, D, A

q23386.en: At the junction shown in the picture, vehicles A and R pass at the same time.

explain.short: A has D on its right, so A must wait for D, and D waits for R. A goes last.
explain.rule: With no signs, give way to vehicles coming from your RIGHT (precedenza a destra). A vehicle turning left also lets oncoming traffic pass. An oversized vehicle (veicolo eccezionale) has no special priority.
explain.trap: 'contemporaneamente' (at the same time) is wrong: D passes between R and A.

sceneParams.caption: Wrong: A waits for D, after R
